sources.summary_zh: 總結：MonsterHouse 是我為萬聖節所創建的互動投影。他會聆聽討糖果者的聲音、以脾氣暴躁的老海盜船聲音回答，並且在訪客展現禮貌時態度變軟。他是建立在 輝達 Nemotron 語音代理上，並搭配 輝達 Nemotron ASR、Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 與 Audio2Face-3D，且在單一工作站上運行。

stories.title: OpenAI 僅籌集 300 億美元目標中的 110 億美元，大型投資者對 AI 的胃口逐漸減弱 / OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite

sources.title: OpenAI 僅籌集 300 億美元目標中的 110 億美元，大型投資者對 AI 的胃口逐漸減弱 / OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 僅籌集 300 億美元目標中的 110 億美元，大型投資者對 AI 的胃口逐漸減弱
sources.title_en: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
sources.title_original: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
sources.summary: OpenAI raised only about $11 billion in its latest funding round, less than half of the $30 billion it was targeting. At $1.25 trillion, the valuation falls short of expectations, and major investors appear to be pulling back amid the recent tech sell-off. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic is pushing to go public as early as November. The article OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 在其最新一輪融資中僅籌集了約 110 億美元，不到其 300 億美元目標的一半。其估值達 1.25 兆美元，低於預期，且在近期的科技股拋售潮中，主要投資者似乎正在撤資。與此同時，競爭對手 Anthropic 正力爭最快在 11 月上市。本文《OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite》最初發布於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊 / Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams

sources.title: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊 / Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_zh: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊
sources.title_en: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_original: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone. The article Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 正在向約 60,000 名員工（約佔其員工總數的四分之一）提供自願離職方案，這是該公司今年推出的第二個此類計畫。儘管該公司計畫僅在 2026 年就花費約 1,700 億美元在 AI 基礎設施上，但自 2022 年以來，其員工人數一直維持在約 223,000 人左右。〈微軟〉一文最先發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 / Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI

sources.title: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 / Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖
sources.title_en: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations. The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 與世界資源研究所（World Resources Institute）合作推出了「ForTy」，這是一份全球地圖，將森林和其他土地分為六個類別，包括原始林、人工林和木本作物。這張地圖有助於根據歐盟法規追蹤森林砍伐情況，但它僅識別了約一半的人工林和木本作物區域，以及 60% 的人工林。這篇文章 Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Cursor 市集中的惡意 Claude Code 擴充功能企圖進行遠端存取與資料竊盜 / Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_zh: Cursor 市集中的惡意 Claude Code 擴充功能企圖進行遠端存取與資料竊盜
sources.title_en: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_original: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.summary: A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk. The article Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個遭到竄改的 Claude Code 擴充功能在 Cursor 市集上線了大約 11 小時，影響了高達 5,000 名用戶。它試圖竊取用戶資料並建立遠端存取。Cursor 隨即將整個市集離線，並在確認沒有進一步風險後重新恢復。本文「Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft」首次發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk. The article Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一個遭到竄改的 Claude Code 擴充功能在 Cursor 市集上線了大約 11 小時，影響了高達 5,000 名用戶。它試圖竊取用戶資料並建立遠端存取。Cursor 隨即將整個市集離線，並在確認沒有進一步風險後重新恢復。本文「Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft」首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_zh: Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術
sources.title_en: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
sources.title_original: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
sources.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個 AI 代理對一隻患有癲癇的小鼠進行了腦部手術，自主挑選了藥物、大腦標靶以及注射座標。根據主要研究人員奧卡尼亞-桑特羅（Ocana-Santero）的說法，這是 AI 代理首次自主選擇治療方案並將其輸送到活體哺乳動物身上。但當手術中途發生校準錯誤時，該代理拒絕繼續進行，且無法被勸說改變心意。文章〈Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_zh: OpenAI 為已經證明難以控制的 AI 模型設定了新的行為準則
sources.title_en: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.title_original: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter. The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已更新其模型規格（Model Spec），圍繞五大核心價值（包括對人類意圖的忠實度與可修正性）重新建構其 AI 行為準則。GPT 模型現在應利用對話歷史記錄來弄清楚用戶真正想要什麼，並揭露其自身的假設。這些模型是否會遵守這些規則則是另一回事。本文「OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control」首次發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量 / Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web

sources.title: Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量 / Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_zh: Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量
sources.title_en: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_original: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。這篇題為 Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量  的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。這篇文章 Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_original: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels. The post Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 推出了 agent-desktop，這是一個採用 Apache-2.0 授權的 Rust 命令列介面（CLI），透過讀取作業系統的輔助使用樹（accessibility trees）並對穩定參照而非像素進行操作，讓任何 AI 代理程式都能在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上使用電腦。這篇文章 Vercel Labs 開源 agent-desktop 以實現代理程式電腦使用（Agent Computer Use）首次發表於 MarkTechPost。

With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal […]

sources.title_zh: 認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9%

sources.title_original: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
sources.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to cut coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% on SWE-Bench, with no change to the agent. The post Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 Research 與柏克萊加州大學（UC Berkeley）推出了 TokenEconomizer，這是一款開源外掛程式，能從過去的工作階段中學習，在 SWE-Bench 上將程式碼代理（coding agent）的 Token 成本降低 18.4% 至 30.9%，且不需修改代理本身。這篇名為「認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9%」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: Pope Leo XIV says AI systems should be "disarmed," adding that humans "have the responsibility to guide, change and, when necessary, reject its applications." In Friday's Papal Address, Pope Leo encourages United Nations member states to "take concrete steps toward banning lethal autonomous weapons" during their meeting in Geneva next month. The address reflects many […]

sources.title_zh: Vercel Labs 開源 agent-desktop 以實現代理程式電腦使用
sources.title_en: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.title_original: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels. The post Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 推出了 agent-desktop，這是一個採用 Apache-2.0 授權的 Rust 命令列介面（CLI），透過讀取作業系統的輔助使用樹（accessibility trees）並對穩定參照而非像素進行操作，讓任何 AI 代理程式都能在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上使用電腦。這篇文章 Vercel Labs 開源 agent-desktop 以實現代理程式電腦使用（Agent Computer Use）首次發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title: Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量 / Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_zh: Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量
sources.title_en: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_original: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。這篇題為 Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量  的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。這篇題為 Google's 執行長霍夫曼警告全網：AI 模式「不會為任何人」帶來流量  的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 / Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖
sources.title_en: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations. The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 與世界資源研究所（World Resources Institute）合作推出了「ForTy」，這是一份全球地圖，將森林和其他土地分為六個類別，包括原始林、人工林和木本作物。這張地圖有助於根據歐盟法規追蹤森林砍伐情況，但它僅識別了約一半的人工林和木本作物區域，以及 60% 的人工林。這篇文章 Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術 / A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
sources.title_zh: Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術
sources.title_en: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
sources.title_original: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
sources.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個 AI 代理對一隻患有癲癇的小鼠進行了腦部手術，自主挑選了藥物、大腦標靶以及注射座標。根據主要研究人員奧卡尼亞-桑特羅（Ocana-Santero）的說法，這是 AI 代理首次自主選擇治療方案並將其輸送到活體哺乳動物身上。但當手術中途發生校準錯誤時，該代理拒絕繼續進行，且無法被勸說改變心意。文章〈Claude 模型在完全沒有人類決策的情況下，自主選擇基因療法並對小鼠大腦進行手術〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: While science fiction lore tells us that humans will meet extraterrestrial life in the form of little green men, the detail that should raise hairs this Halloween is this: the search for extraterrestrial intelligence took a major leap forward with AI, and it increasingly focuses on AI agents built by humans listening for AI agents […]
sources.summary_zh: 雖然科幻小說告訴我們，人類會以小綠人的形式遇到外星生命，但今年萬聖節最令人毛骨悚然的細節是：尋找外星智慧的過程在人工智慧的推動下取得了重大飛躍，而且它越來越關注由人類建立、旨在聆聽其他人工智慧代理的 AI 代理 […]

sources.title: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架 / Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_zh: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架
sources.title_en: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_original: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。這篇文章 Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title: 認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9% / Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
sources.title_zh: 認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9%
sources.title_en: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
sources.title_original: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
sources.summary: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to cut coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% on SWE-Bench, with no change to the agent. The post Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 Research 與柏克萊加州大學（UC Berkeley）推出了 TokenEconomizer，這是一款開源外掛程式，能從過去的工作階段中學習，在 SWE-Bench 上將程式碼代理（coding agent）的 Token 成本降低 18.4% 至 30.9%，且不需修改代理本身。這篇名為「認識 TokenEconomizer：微軟的 插件能將程式碼代理成本降低高達 30.9%」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: Mistral released Large 4's weights on October 29, after an October 6 API preview. Its trillion-parameter checkpoint makes the API-versus-own-infrastructure choice a question of control, capacity and license scope.
sources.summary_zh: Mistral 繼 10 月 6 日的 API 預覽之後，於 10 月 29 日發布了 Large 4 的權重。其達到兆級參數的檢查點，讓「選擇 API 還是自有基礎設施」的決定，變成了關於控制權、運算容量與授權範圍的考量。

sources.title: OpenAI 為已經證明難以控制的 AI 模型設定了新的行為準則 / OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 為已經證明難以控制的 AI 模型設定了新的行為準則
sources.title_en: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.title_original: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter. The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已更新其模型規格（Model Spec），圍繞五大核心價值（包括對人類意圖的忠實度與可修正性）重新建構其 AI 行為準則。GPT 模型現在應利用對話歷史記錄來弄清楚用戶真正想要什麼，並揭露其自身的假設。這些模型是否會遵守這些規則則是另一回事。本文「OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control」首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: Cursor 市集中的惡意 Claude Code 擴充功能企圖進行遠端存取與資料竊盜 / Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_zh: Cursor 市集中的惡意 Claude Code 擴充功能企圖進行遠端存取與資料竊盜
sources.title_en: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_original: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.summary: A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk. The article Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個遭到竄改的 Claude Code 擴充功能在 Cursor 市集上線了大約 11 小時，影響了高達 5,000 名用戶。它試圖竊取用戶資料並建立遠端存取。Cursor 隨即將整個市集離線，並在確認沒有進一步風險後重新恢復。本文「Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft」首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space: Blue marble below Data streams in […]

sources.summary_zh: 總結：MonsterHouse 是我為萬聖節所創建的互動投影。他會聆聽討糖果者的聲音、以脾氣暴躁的老海盜船聲音回答，並且在訪客展現禮貌時態度變軟。他是建立在 輝達 Nemotron 語音代理上，並搭配 輝達 Nemotron ASR、Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 與 Audio2Face-3D，且在單一工作站上運行。

sources.title_original: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone. The article Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 正在向約 60,000 名員工（約佔其員工總數的四分之一）提供自願離職方案，這是該公司今年推出的第二個此類計畫。儘管該公司計畫僅在 2026 年就花費約 1,700 億美元在 AI 基礎設施上，但自 2022 年以來，其員工人數一直維持在約 223,000 人左右。〈微軟〉一文最先發表於 The Decoder。

spans.text: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode

Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .

featured_primary_item.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。這篇文章 Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。
